title: Identity Through Boundaries
reward: Learn that source identity is transformed by infrastructure.
knowledge: Distinguish public, cloud-private, overlay, container and loopback contexts.
NAT, proxy and overlay can transform observed source identity.
Preserve where a source value was observed and how much it can prove.
Container bridge addresses are topology, not Internet attacker identities.
Same subnet does not imply same actor.
challenge: Trace source identity through proxy/NAT boundaries.
State what cannot be inferred from an IP alone.
next_requires: Attach identity claims to observation boundaries.
